headline: Falcons at Buccaneers is 1 November, not Thursday Night Football
whyCareReason: StatMuse lists Atlanta at Tampa Bay on Sunday 1 November. The 8 October prime-time game is Tampa Bay at Dallas.
teaser: Do not use this card as the Week 5 TNF. Records as of 8 October: Falcons 2-2, Buccaneers 0-4.
story: The Falcons are not playing the Buccaneers on 8 October. ESPN's Week 5 Thursday game is Tampa Bay at Dallas. A Falcons schedule lists Sunday 1 November, Atlanta at Tampa Bay, 1:00 p.m. ET. Atlanta are 2-2. Tampa Bay are 0-4 after a 17-14 loss to Green Bay.
stakes: A division game in November, not the Thursday opener.
rivalryAngle: NFC South, later. The Thursday night stake is in Arlington.
